import json, subprocess
OK = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
def run(doc, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip(), p.stderr.decode()[:300]
def case(name, doc, raw=None, want_error=True):
    code, out, err = run(doc, raw)
    ok = (code == 0) and (out == '{"error":"input"}' if want_error else out != '{"error":"input"}')
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), name, '->', out[:100], err[:120] if not ok else '')
    return ok
base = json.loads(json.dumps(OK))
case('valid base', base, want_error=False)
def t(name, mutate, raw=None):
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(OK)); mutate(doc); case(name, doc, raw)
t('missing key', lambda d: d.pop('seed'))
t('extra key', lambda d: d.update(x=1))
t('seed too long', lambda d: d.update(seed='a'*65))
t('seed bad char', lambda d: d.update(seed='a b'))
t('seed type', lambda d: d.update(seed=5))
t('timeout 0', lambda d: d.update(timeout_ms=0))
t('timeout big', lambda d: d.update(timeout_ms=10**9+1))
t('timeout bool', lambda d: d.update(timeout_ms=True))
t('timeout float', lambda d: d.update(timeout_ms=1.0))
t('timeout str', lambda d: d.update(timeout_ms='5'))
t('definitions not list', lambda d: d.update(definitions={}))
t('definitions too many', lambda d: d.update(definitions=[['a',"b'x'"]]*8193))
t('cases too many', lambda d: d.update(cases=[{"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}} for i in range(2001)]))
